description: This file implements a VirtualInput class for handling various input events such as keyboard, mouse, and touch inputs, including mapping, dispatching, and communication with external systems. It also includes platform-specific implementations for Linux input devices and IPC mechanisms.

classes.name: InputEvent
classes.description: A helper class for creating string representations of input events (keyboard, mouse, touch) for logging or debugging.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Main class handling input events, key mapping, modifiers, and dispatching events to registered notifiers. Includes platform-specific code for Linux input devices and IPC mechanisms.

classes.name: IPCUserInput
classes.description: Implementation of VirtualInput that communicates via IPC, allowing remote or inter-process input event handling.

classes.name: LinuxKeyboardInput
classes.description: Platform-specific implementation for Linux input devices, managing virtual keyboard input via uinput.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports a key mapping table into the VirtualInput's key map.

methods.name: Export
methods.description: Exports the current key map to a JSON array.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notifier callback for input events.

methods.name: KeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key press/release events, mapping codes and dispatching.

methods.name: SendModifier
methods.description: Manages modifier key states and triggers.

methods.name: DispatchRegisteredKey
methods.description: Dispatches key events to registered notifiers and manages repeat logic.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Updates device key states based on input changes.

methods.name: LookupChanges
methods.description: Reloads or updates key mappings based on external links.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens platform-specific input devices or IPC channels.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes platform-specific input devices or IPC channels.
